elements.requirement: Anything done by a person in the course of that person's employment must be treated as also done by their employer.
elements.quote: Anything done by a person (A) in the course of A's employment must be treated as also done by the employer.

elements.requirement: Anything done by an agent for a principal, with the authority of the principal, must be treated as also done by the principal.
elements.quote: Anything done by an agent for a principal, with the authority of the principal, must be treated as also done by the principal.

elements.requirement: Liability applies regardless of whether the thing done by the employee or agent was done with the employer's or principal's knowledge or approval.
elements.quote: It does not matter whether that thing is done with the employer's or principal's knowledge or approval.

elements.requirement: In proceedings against an employer in respect of anything alleged to have been done by an employee in the course of employment, it is a defence for the employer to show that they took all reasonable steps to prevent the employee from doing that thing or from doing anything of that description.
elements.quote: it is a defence for B to show that B took all reasonable steps to prevent A— (a) from doing that thing, or (b) from doing anything of that description.

elements.requirement: The rules on employer and principal liability do not apply to offences under the Equality Act 2010, except for offences under Part 12 relating to disabled persons and transport.
elements.quote: This section does not apply to offences under this Act (other than offences under Part 12 (disabled persons: transport)).
